definition.description: Offline BugSigDB full-dump to raw core products. The core preserves all annotation features including culture-media annotations and incomplete pairs. Count and ORA profiles have distinct, explicit units and host policies, and both keep 16S and shotgun (WMS) experiments only (count_input_16s_wms_v1, #742).
